context: Idle time is only reported after a merge. Nothing makes an orchestrator start the next ready item when a lane ends, so the queue waits for you. Proposed fix in three parts: (1) a global 'keep going' rule (home-app has one): start the next item whose questions are answered, stopping only for your decision, a test only you can run, or the load brake; (2) a final report lists ready items left unstarted, with a reason each; (3) later, only after a repeat, a check that refuses a turn end while ready work waits.

options.how: One rule line and one report line; no new guard.
options.label: Parts 1 and 2 now, part 3 only after a repeat
options.lose: Sessions may run more lanes at once; the load brake still caps them.

options.label: All three now
options.lose: A new guard with no incident yet, against your guard rules.

ref: c59 (no session sits idle while ready work waits)
title: Make sessions start the next ready item instead of waiting
why: It fixes the cause with rules alone, and your guard rule asks for an incident before a new check.
